Medici family mystery may be solved after more than 400 years
item.description:
📝 Now, scientists believe they have an answer — it wasn’t murder, but malaria. Since 2004, when exhumation and analysis of skeletal remains began for 49 Medici family tombs as part of the Medici Project, various studies have confirmed malaria as the cause of Francesco’s demise. Historical sources supported the assumption that malaria killed Francesco and Bianca, Giuffra said.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cnn.com/2026/07/15/science/medici-family-mystery-dna-malaria
